DECISION B successor of dsfd_capt_x8_data_e (split1016 / split1016b: FF hold -84 ps on 3,376 intra-leaf ck->ckv R2R arcs of 8 x ot_ratio_cdc_fifo, hold repair stalled: the 256.67 ps 4:3 window cannot carry the 100 ps hold + 150 ps setup cross-entry reserve).  The 8 dsfd_capt_row_local rows (dynamic hold queue + pair packer + ratio FIFO) become fixed-bank 3:4 transfers on the common epoch (ot_s81_vm_x43 contract) split per clock root: dsfd_capt_x8x_t (ck) samples f_w into bank n at EVERY stream index n = 0..3 (no index is a fault: capture words arrive on any stream cycle); dsfd_capt_x8x_s (ckv) reads b0+b1 at serial edge 2, b2 at edge 0, b3 at edge 1 (stage A) and registers t_vm one serial edge later at the S face (stage B).  Hold queue removed (no word can be refused); t_ho = sticky epoch-slip fault (stream side checks the serial marker/parity).  Latency f_w sample edge -> t_vm: 3.333/2.500/2.778/3.056 ns for n = 0/1/2/3, one serial cycle LESS than the old leaf's best case (measured: tb_dsfd_capt_x8_x43).  Every leaf pin is a flop; outhold off (bank outputs rewritten >= 1.11 ns after their fixed read).  Parent footprint 118.8 x 172.8 (old 108 x 162): bit-major seam needs 1,680 M4 pins at 0.096 um; t width 32.4 for two 10.5 pins/um faces (gate oflop).
